{{recipe}}

'''Hot wings''' are a dish of seasoned and fried chicken wings tossed in a spicy sauce.

==Ingredients==

* 3 oz (85 g) [[Cookbook:Butter|butter]], melted
* 3 oz (85 g) [[Cookbook:Hot Sauce|hot sauce]]
* 3 cloves [[Cookbook:Garlic|garlic]], [[Cookbook:Mince|minced]]
* 2 [[Cookbook:Teaspoon|tsp]] [[Cookbook:Soy sauce|soy sauce]]
*[[Cookbook:Oil and Fat|Oil]] for [[Cookbook:Deep Fat Frying|deep frying]]

*12 whole [[Cookbook:Chicken|chicken]] wings, tip removed and cut in half
* 1 [[Cookbook:Tablespoon|tbsp]] seasoned [[Cookbook:Salt|salt]]
* 1 tbsp [[Cookbook:Black Pepper|black pepper]]

==Procedure==
#To make the sauce, combine melted butter, hot sauce, minced garlic, and soy sauce in a stainless steel bowl.
#Preheat oil to 350°F (180°C).
#Combine seasoning salt, pepper, and wings. [[Cookbook:Mixing|Toss]] to coat.
#[[Cookbook:Frying|Fry]] wings in batches in oil for 11 minutes. Drain on a rack. Do not use paper towels—they will make the food greasy.
#Toss wings with sauce and serve warm.
